name: Stormscript Tempest
introDiscord:
Lightning writes glowing symbols across the water.

Stormscript Squid add ink between the flashes.

The result resembles someone doing mathematics during a thunderstorm.
introTwitch:
Lightning writes glowing symbols across the water.

Stormscript Squid add ink between the flashes.

The result resembles someone doing mathematics during a thunderstorm.

stormscript-tempest-approach.prompt: Three impossible routes open across Stormscript Tempest.

left.message:
Star Candies sit beneath a glowing equation.

Shizuki added:

'+ Berry = better.'

right.message:
A Stormscript Squid writes something with ink.

Lightning answers.

Apparently that was a combat spell.

forward.message:
A quiet gap between equations restores you.

Shizuki's note:

'Tried solving storm.

Storm gave me headache.

Taking break.'
forward.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

stormscript-tempest-depths.prompt: Deeper within Stormscript Tempest, three paths bend through the unstable Nexus.

left.message: A Squid writes a spiral that becomes actual lightning.

right.message: A cache appears at the end of a completed equation.

forward.message:
One Berry rests beneath Shizuki's contribution:

'2 + 2 = 4.

I helped.'

stormscript-tempest-threshold.prompt: Near Formula of Thunder, three final routes cross the edge of reality.

left.message: A blank section of storm provides restorative calm.
left.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

right.message: A Stormscript Squid corrects Shizuki's equation aggressively.

forward.message: Star Candies orbit the final symbol.

boss-antechamber.name: Formula of Thunder
boss-antechamber.prompt: Formula of Thunder fills the entire chamber.

bossPromptDiscord:
Formula of Thunder fills the entire chamber.

One enormous creature begins completing the equation with its tentacles.

Use /yes to continue or /no to accept that math has become
too dangerous.
bossPromptTwitch:
Formula of Thunder fills the entire chamber.

One enormous creature begins completing the equation with its tentacles.

Use !yes to continue or !no to accept that math has become
too dangerous.
bossRetreatText: You withdraw from Formula of Thunder. The impossible guardian will wait.

boss.revealText:
The equation completes.

Lightning takes form.

Living Equation Krakenet reveals itself!

completionText:
The storm erases itself.

Shizuki's '2 + 2 = 4' survives.

Highest-quality scholarship in the chamber.
